g01 bus emit invokes handlers in registration order and returns the count
g01 bus on and off return the bus, dedupe handlers and ignore unknown offs
g01 emit snapshot: handlers added during emit run later, removed ones still run
g02 constructor validates bus then now
g02 schedule returns the exact view shape and creates one subscription per job
g02 schedule validates id first then runAtMs, and rejects duplicate non-terminal ids
g02 an id whose job is terminal may be scheduled again and replaces it
g03 start transitions only pending jobs and stamps startedAt with now
g03 start on unknown, done or cancelled jobs returns false with no now call
g03 done uses now when atMs is not finite; done on a pending job leaves nulls
g03 done events for other ids, non-object payloads and terminal jobs affect nothing
g04 cancel of a running job unsubscribes and stamps endedAt from now
g04 cancel of a never-started pending job also unsubscribes
g04 a later done emit after cancel is a no-op in both cancel paths
g04 cancel returns false for unknown and terminal jobs without side effects
g05 stats counts all lifecycle states and snapshot reflects done timing
g05 snapshot returns a fresh array of fresh plain objects each call
g05 rescheduled id after cancel replaces the record and runs a fresh lifecycle
g05 subscriber count returns to zero and a cancelled job among done jobs is intact
g05 scheduler works with the default now (Date.now) without asserting on time
